title: Lock In - PPLUL w/ Zone 2 and Core
author: Matt P.
desc: The purpose of this program is to build measurable strength over 10 weeks through a high‑intensity PPLUL training cycle.  All compound lifts are targeted using percentage of 1RM, allowing users to progressively overload at their own pace.  Zone 2 cardio conditioning and targeted accessory work are added to support progression and muscular endurance.
